Name: Side Pockets
Author: yogiero
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Give your tools and weapons their own space with [b]Side Pocket[/b]. This mod adds eight extra equipment slots beside your inventory. Open your inventory with [b]E[/b], then click the arrow on the left to show or hide the slots.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Eight persistent equipment slots in a two-column, four-row layout.[/*]
[*]Store tools and weapons, including fishing rods, the Milk Pail, and shears.[/*]
[*]Left-click an item in your inventory to pick it up, then left-click a Side Pocket slot to place it.[/*]
[*]Left-click an occupied Side Pocket slot to pick up its item; left-click an inventory slot or another Side Pocket slot to place it.[/*]
[*]Right-click an occupied Side Pocket slot to move the item to the first empty slot in your regular inventory.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer[/*]
[/list]Developed with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. No other mods are required.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Extract [b]Side Pocket 1.0.0.zip[/b] into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Confirm the extracted
[code]SidePocket[/code]folder directly contains:
[code]manifest.json
SidePocket.dll[/code][/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Credits[/heading]
Created by [b]Yogiero[/b]. Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, and the SMAPI team for its modding framework
